title: Quickly Fried Norwegian Goose Skewers
description: A savory Norwegian dish featuring goose fat and agemono deep fry, served in a Korean brass bowl, this recipe is perfect for a special occasion.
instructions: Preheat the deep fryer to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together almond flour, salt, black pepper, paprika, and garlic powder.
In a separate bowl, whisk together egg and a pinch of salt.
Dip each piece of goose breast into the egg mixture, then coat in the almond flour mixture.
Thread 2-3 pieces of coated goose breast onto each bamboo skewer.
Fry the skewers in batches for 3-4 minutes on each side, or until golden brown.
Using a slotted spoon, remove the skewers from the deep fryer and place on a paper towel lined plate to drain excess fat.
Serve the skewers in a Korean brass bowl, drizzled with melted goose fat and garnished with chopped fresh parsley.
Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F before serving.
